     3→/**
     4→ * 각 cache, fetcher 마다 사용하는 key의 형태가 다르기 때문에 공통의 id를 key로써 사용하고 캐시의 실제 키는 각 캐시 내부에서 처리합니다.
     5→ */
     6→class DefaultTieredLoadingCache<ID, V>(
     7→    private val localCache: LocalCache<ID, V>,
     8→    private val globalCache: GlobalCache<ID, V>,
     9→    private val fetcher: (Collection<ID>) -> Map<ID, V>,
    10→) : TieredLoadingCache<ID, V> {
    11→
    12→    override fun get(id: ID): V? {
    13→        // 1. L1
    14→        localCache.get(id)?.let { return it }
    15→
    16→        // 2. L2
    17→        val globalCached = globalCache.getAll(listOf(id))
    18→        globalCached[id]?.let {
    19→            localCache.put(id, it)
    20→            return it
    21→        }
    22→
    23→        // 3. L3
    24→        val fetched = fetcher(listOf(id))
    25→        fetched[id]?.let {
    26→            localCache.put(id, it)
    27→            globalCache.putAll(mapOf(id to it))
    28→            return it
    29→        }
    30→
    31→        // 4. All missed
    32→        return null
    33→    }
    34→
    35→    override fun getAll(ids: Collection<ID>): Map<ID, V?> {
    36→        if (ids.isEmpty()) return emptyMap()
    37→
    38→        // 1. L1
    39→        val localCached = localCache.getAll(ids)
    40→        val localMiss = localCached.filterValues { it == null }
    41→        if (localMiss.keys.isEmpty()) return localCached
    42→
    43→        // 2. L2
    44→        val globalCached = globalCache.getAll(localMiss.keys)
    45→        val globalHit = globalCached.filterValues { it != null }.mapValues { it.value!! }
    46→        val globalMiss = globalCached.filterValues { it == null }
    47→        if (globalHit.isNotEmpty()) {
    48→            localCache.putAll(globalHit)
    49→        }
    50→        if (globalMiss.isEmpty()) return localCached + globalCached
    51→
    52→        // 3. L3
    53→        val fetched = fetcher(globalMiss.keys)
    54→        if (fetched.isNotEmpty()) {
    55→            localCache.putAll(fetched)
    56→            globalCache.putAll(fetched)
    57→        }
    58→
    59→        return localCached + globalCached + fetched
    60→    }
    61→}
